title: Locate large European localized gap candidates
changes: Identify four candidate five-language pointer groups inside the remaining unowned portions of ten larger localized intervals.
validation: Protected static census xuhbm61i reconciles E300 ownership and scans aligned little-endian 08-region values into 95307 unowned bytes.
limitations: Candidate values do not prove execution, original readers, source boundaries or ownership of intervening bytes. Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No gameplay replay or performance comparison was made.
